description: This file contains functions for processing code snippets, including filtering snippets based on access rights, converting file paths, and retrieving processed snippets with associated metadata for autocomplete features in a VSCode extension.

methods.name: uriToFsPath
methods.description: Converts a file URI to a filesystem path if it starts with 'file://', otherwise returns the input path.

methods.name: hasFilepath
methods.description: Type guard to check if a snippet has a filepath and is of type Code or Static.

methods.name: filterSnippetsByAccess
methods.description: Filters snippets based on access rights provided by a RooIgnoreController, with timeout handling.

methods.name: getProcessedSnippets
methods.description: Main function to process, filter, and return snippets with metadata, converting paths to URIs and initializing context.
